summary: Add an unwired revision-keyed iOS sidebar projection cache and plan from borrowed trees

compatibility.detail: V2 planning now consumes a projected tree; all callers migrated. The single-entry host-owned cache invalidates on model, arrangement, membership frontier, catalog, presentation and scope changes, not unrelated snapshot writes. Hosts must clear on unavailable data and treat returned trees as borrowed.

downtime.detail: No restart required; production host remains unwired.

manual.detail: SIDEBAR_IOS_PERF=1 nix develop .#web --command pnpm --dir apps/ios test sidebarBehavior.test.mjs measures warm cached projection plus planning and pending-state staging against 4 ms and 2x v1, reporting cold projection separately without a cold gate. The v1 baseline normalizes its legacy payload for the same pending transition. Native release overlay/frame and D socket acceptance remain prerequisites before activation.

recovery.detail: Revert this unwired cache and harness change.
